citations.claim: At first violating step body 0 centre is at x~9.97 inside penetration zone of wall (distance -0.396, exceeds 0.15 limit)
One step before impact body was outside wall approaching fast at ~30.8 m/s toward wall

counterfactual.change: Reduced initial horizontal speed vx from -27.56 to -10.0 only; slower side impact no longer penetrates, so failure needs high-speed impact.

explanation: High-speed nearly-horizontal impact into thin wall side overwhelms impulse plus positional correction: body arrives at ~31 m/s with dt~0.0236 (25 substeps), contacts wall side between steps 12-13, solver flips vx (bounce) but leaves centre 0.396 deep inside wall, exceeding 0.15 allowed overlap. Lowering impact speed removes failure, implicating inadequate substep/CCD handling for fast side collisions.
vision_note: The red ball travels left toward the right end-face of the grey horizontal wall from steps 10 to 12. In step 13 it fails to stop at the surface and ends up embedded overlapping the wall corner.
